  ACI: 10,
  JER: 15,
  LGW: 55,

  LCY: 55,
  MAN: 60,
  BRS: 40,

  CDG: 45,
  EMA: 65,
  DUB: 60,
  EDI: 75,
  ZRH: 100,
  LBA: 70,
  GRQ: 75,
};

}
